summary: A jazz trio firmware: you play chords and small neural networks running on the FM-1 add a walking bass and a swing drummer that learn the tune's form and follow you.
features: Recognises seven chord types on twelve roots; root must be lowest
Learns the tune's form and keeps playing when you stop
Feel in two, in four, or two then four
Teach the bass your own line; it fine-tunes on the device
Knobs for tempo, bass freedom, drum activity and swing
MIDI keyboards over USB, TRS or Bluetooth; early 0.1.1 release
